units.rawText:
The sudden explosion obliterated a corner of the building, the remnants of the structure scattering like a cement avalanche towards the Earth.
Amidst the plummeting mass of residue and gravel, a familiar figure could be spotted. A blue ribbon, once always tied around his arm, was no longer bound to its master. It descended tenderly and slowly, a world apart from its surroundings.
